products.name: Gunung Puntang
products.description: A clean and expressive West Java roast with floral aromatics, bright citrus, and a soft honeyed finish. It is a reliable daily brew for filter and espresso drinkers who enjoy clarity.
products.brew: V60 pour over at 1:15, 92C water, medium grind.

products.name: Ciwidey Honey Process
products.description: A celebrated microlot from the volcanic slopes of Ciwidey. The honey process gives this coffee a syrupy body, gentle red fruit acidity, and a long almond sweetness.
products.brew: AeroPress inverted method with 15g coffee, 200g water, and a 2 minute steep.

products.name: Pangalengan Blend
products.description: A comforting blend built for milk drinks and full-bodied manual brewing. Expect deep chocolate, caramel sweetness, and a rounded finish.
products.brew: French press with coarse grind, 4 minute steep, and slow plunge.

products.name: Kamojang Estate
products.description: A balanced single origin from Garut with a sweet structure and crisp aromatic lift. It works beautifully as a clean morning filter brew.
products.brew: Kalita or V60 with gentle pulses and 92C water.

products.name: Malabar Classic
products.description: A classic Indonesian profile with a bold body, low acidity, and warm spice character. Designed for moka pot, tubruk, and milk-forward cups.
products.brew: Moka pot or tubruk with medium-fine grind.

products.name: Gunung Tilu
products.description: A lively natural coffee with fruit-forward sweetness and a delicate floral finish. Best for people who like bright, expressive brews.
products.brew: Origami dripper or AeroPress with a medium-fine grind.
